action.objective: Commit Rg2+, the verified checking move with exact depth-4 evidence and no refutations.
action.rationale: Single-candidate verification of f2g2 completed at depth 4 with exact score 700, safety.complete true, tactical_refutation not_found, and no proven refutations. Rg2+ checks the king on g7, drives it away, keeps the rook active on the second rank, and the PV resolves the a8-rook threat favorably via g2h2 after ad8h8. This is the sole commit_ready move; no stronger alternative exists with usable verification.
